name: m8_hex_screw_threadlen
description: Hex head screw M8x50 ISO 4014 with EXPLICIT thread reach 30 mm — exercises the structured thread_length_mm recipe knob (not the ISO-888 default).

stages.prompt: Hex head screw M8, ISO 4014, total length under head 50 mm, thread length 30 mm (partial thread — 20 mm unthreaded shank under the head). Single standard fastener, mm units, head at the bottom on the XY plane, axis along Z.
